title: Stateful interrogation activation and confirmation
purpose: Exercise a deeper valid state path by sending a framed interrogation activation followed by a framed activation confirmation on the same common address and object address.
expected_behavior: A tolerant implementation should parse both frames as valid C_IC_NA_1 ASDUs and expose activation then activation-confirmation handling for station interrogation qualifier 20.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use complete 104 framing with documented start byte and control field slot
Length 0x0f is consistent for each message
Qualifier of interrogation value 20 is used as documented for station interrogation
ASDU field order is preserved in both request and confirmation
Cause values 6 and 7 are used exactly as documented
Common address and information object address remain stable across the sequence
issue_safety_notes: Sequence is stateful but conservative. It uses only documented type IDs, cause values, and interrogation qualifier values.
